question: How many customers are there?
List the names of all products in the Electronics category.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE category = 'Electronics'

question: How many orders were cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'cancelled'

question: Which customers are from France?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE country = 'France'

question: What is the most expensive product?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products ORDER BY price_cents DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders has each customer placed?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name

question: How many units of each product were sold, not counting cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY p.id, p.name

question: What is the total revenue in dollars from shipped orders?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(p.price_cents * oi.quantity) / 100.0 FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped'

question: Which customer spent the most on shipped orders?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(p.price_cents * oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which products have never been ordered?
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT product_id FROM order_items)

question: How many orders were placed in September 2025?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2025-09-01' AND order_date < '2025-10-01'

question: List the customers who signed up before May 2025, oldest signup first.
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE signup_date < '2025-05-01' ORDER BY signup_date

question: What is the average order value in dollars, excluding cancelled orders?
gold_sql: SELECT AVG(total) FROM (SELECT SUM(p.price_cents * oi.quantity) / 100.0 AS total FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' GROUP BY o.id)

question: How many different countries do our customers come from?
Which product category brought in the most revenue from shipped orders?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = 'shipped' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY SUM(p.price_cents * oi.quantity) DESC LIMIT 1

question: How many orders are there in each status?
gold_sql: SELECT status, COUNT(*) FROM orders GROUP BY status

question: Which customers have placed more than one order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: Which products did Omar Haddad order?
gold_sql: SELECT p.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE c.name = 'Omar Haddad'
